ServiceWA._Comment: Leave ClientId empty to use MockWAIdXService for development

Credentry._Comment: Dev Credentry IdP: run the Credentry repo's CE.Api on localhost:5144 (branch feature/numbatwallet-federation — seeds the numbatwallet-admin/numbatwallet-m2m clients). TenantMap keys are LOCAL Credentry tenant GUIDs (instance-specific, created by Credentry's seeder): add yours here or via env var Credentry__TenantMap__<credentry-tid>=<numbat-tenant-id>. The default-scheme selector probes the bearer token's issuer, so with Credentry not running every existing auth path is untouched.

TenantMap._Comment: Local Credentry seeder's 'Acme Corporation' tenant -> local NumbatWallet dev seed tenant. Instance-specific: replace the key with YOUR local Credentry tenant GUID (SELECT id FROM identity.tenants).

FieldEncryption._Comment: DEV-ONLY AES-256-GCM key (base64, 32 bytes). Production sources the key from Key Vault (set Source=KeyVault + KeyVaultUri).

Search._Comment: DEV-ONLY pepper (base64) for deterministic email/phone search tokens. Must stay stable across restarts or stored tokens (and login) break. Production sources it from Key Vault secret 'search-token-pepper'.
